question: Should the additive QA Plugin SDK transportPolicy option and group QA target type be accepted as the permanent contract for canonical channel routing QA?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but SDK surface changes become public plugin contract and require maintainer intent rather than automated cleanup judgment.

options.title: Accept Additive QA Contract
options.body: Proceed with the narrow QA-only SDK expansion after exact-head checks finish cleanly.

options.title: Keep Policy Internal
options.body: Rework the transport policy plumbing to stay inside QA Lab internals before merge.

options.title: Pause For SDK Design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a broader QA runner adapter-options policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Additive QA Contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with the narrow QA-only SDK expansion after exact-head checks finish cleanly.
